practice.name: Problem 22 (2016 AMC 10A)
practice.statement: For some positive integer n, the number 110n^3 has 110 positive integer divisors, including 1 and the number 110n^3. How many positive integer divisors does the number 81n^4 have?

practice.name: Problem 19 (2019 AMC 10B)
practice.statement: Let S be the set of all positive integer divisors of 100,000. How many numbers are the product of two distinct elements of S?

practice.name: Problem 5 (1990 AIME I)
practice.statement: Let n be the smallest positive integer that is a multiple of 75 and has exactly 75 positive integral divisors, including 1 and itself. Find n/75.

practice.name: Problem 9 (2019 AIME I)
practice.statement: Let tau(n) denote the number of positive integer divisors of n. Find the sum of the six least positive integers n that are solutions to tau(n) + tau(n+1) = 7.

practice.name: Problem 8 (2004 AIME II)
practice.statement: How many positive integer divisors of 2004^2004 are divisible by exactly 2004 positive integers?

practice.name: Problem 11 (2016 AIME II)
practice.statement: For positive integers N and k, define N to be k-nice if there exists a positive integer a such that a^k has exactly N positive divisors. Find the number of positive integers less than 1000 that are neither 7-nice nor 8-nice.

practice.name: Problem 9 (2012 AIME II)
practice.statement: Find the number of positive integers that are divisors of at least one of 10^10, 15^7, and 18^11.

practice.name: Problem 2 (2020 AIME II)
practice.statement: Let n = 2^31 * 3^19. How many positive integer divisors of n^2 are less than n but do not divide n?
